Start with one app. Grow into many.

Collaborator limits are proposed and count people invited to an app, excluding its owner. They are not limits on the people using your finished app. Shared workspaces and collaboration require a paid plan; workspace membership is separate from the per-app collaborator limit. Building by collaborators uses the app owner’s credits. A source download includes code, not app users or business data; version restore changes code, not data. Custom-domain registration is purchased separately.

One credit value. Every plan.

100 credits = $1 of Atomic usage. Credits pay for building and running your apps at Atomic’s usage rates. The same work uses the same credits on every plan; charges can be fractional, based on the resources used. For example, 15 credits means $0.15 of Atomic usage. A credit is not a message or a completed app.

A FEW PRACTICAL DETAILS

Before you choose.

Can I subscribe today?

Not yet. These are proposed launch plans. The early-access form adds you to the waitlist; it does not create an account, reserve a price, or start a subscription.

What is included in the subscription?

Builder includes 2,500 monthly credits and up to 10 published apps for $25/month. Pro includes 5,000 monthly credits and up to 20 published apps for $50/month. Both include a backend, database, user authentication, team collaboration, custom domains, private projects, and source downloads. Builder proposes 5 invited collaborators per app; Pro proposes 10. Collaborators can work together with Editor and Admin roles, using the app owner’s credits. Your subscription pays for the platform as well as the included usage.

How does Free work?

The proposed Free plan includes 250 credits each month, used at up to 50 a day. Build on your own and publish one app on an Atomic subdomain, with a small “Made with Atomic” badge. One of your apps can have a backend, database, and user sign-in; your other apps keep their screens on sample data. You can browse your apps’ source; downloading it, collaboration, custom domains, removing the badge, credit purchases, and backends for more apps require Builder or Pro. When the day’s or the month’s credits are used, wait for them to renew or upgrade to keep building.

Do unused credits expire?

Monthly subscription credits reset at renewal and do not roll over. Purchased top-up credits do not expire. Monthly credits are used before purchased credits. Free’s monthly credits reset the same way.

Is hosting included?

Your included credits can pay for metered hosting and persistent storage. Hosting is not unlimited, and storage can still cost credits when an app is stopped. We plan to let you protect part of your balance for hosting. Storage, bandwidth, concurrency limits, and hosting exhaustion and retention rules will be published before billing opens.

What happens when my credits run out?

There are no automatic overage charges. New builds require enough available credits. On Free, wait for your monthly credits to renew or upgrade. On Builder and Pro, you can buy 1,000 more credits for $10 or wait for your monthly allowance to renew. Published apps pause when your credits run out: visitors see that the app is paused, and its data is kept. Adding credits, or your next monthly allowance, starts it again. An app that stays paused for 90 days is permanently deleted, with its data, users, source and versions, and cannot be recovered. We email you a week before and again a day before. The planned hosting-budget control will let you set aside credits that building cannot spend.

Will there be annual billing?

The launch proposal is monthly billing only. Annual plans and discounts have not been announced.

What happens if I cancel?

Cancellation, data retention, export access, and the behavior of published apps will be specified in the final subscription terms before checkout becomes available.
